tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a gradient-modulated siphon driving a coupled memory ODE. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that adds relevant observations for identifying its five parameters before fresh confirmation at H = 0.46.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom, and the narrow horizon range gives little leverage to separate fast memory relaxation from coupling strength.
Neither model accounts for the observed gradient dependence and coupled memory lag.
It does not resolve ambiguity among the coupled ODE parameters.
